KANNIKA · SOUTH PATTAYA SOI 16

Pedicure and foot care in Pattaya

Make time for foot and toenail care at Kannika on South Pattaya Soi 16. We welcome women and men for grooming and foot care, alongside the salon's hair, nails and lash services.

View prices & plan your visit ↗Call the salon ↗

Choose the care you need

The service menu includes cuticle care for hands and feet, foot spa and heel exfoliation, and gel polish for feet. Tell the salon whether you want toenail grooming, foot care, polish or a combination so it can confirm the appropriate booking.

  • Toenail shaping and grooming
  • Cuticle care for feet
  • Foot spa and heel exfoliation
  • Single-colour gel polish for feet

For women and men

Foot care is available for both women and men. You can discuss a grooming-only visit or add a polish finish according to the services listed. If you already have gel polish on your toenails, mention it when requesting a time so the salon can confirm whether removal is needed.

  • Explain the finish you prefer
  • Mention existing gel polish
  • Check the relevant menu items
  • Confirm the final service with the salon

View prices & plan your visit

Check the service menu for prices in Thai baht and confirm the final price with the salon. Online appointment requests need confirmation from the salon.

Before your appointment

Do men need to book a different service?

The salon offers foot care for men and women. Describe what you need when you contact the salon so it can confirm the service.

Does the foot care price include gel polish?

The menu lists foot care and gel polish as service items. Confirm your chosen combination and total price with the salon before starting.
